job.command:
cp shared/* . cp asymmetry/AnConfig.h asymmetry/AnHistograms.cpp . cp asymmetry/collins/CollinsConfig.h asymmetry/collins/CollinsHistograms.h .
@ line_start = ${JOBINDEX} * {{NPERJOB}} + 1 @ line_end = ${line_start} + {{NPERJOB}} - 1 sed -n "${line_start},${line_end}p" {{LISTFILE}} > my_files.list echo "JOBINDEX ${JOBINDEX}: lines ${line_start}-${line_end}, `wc -l < my_files.list` files"
tcsh -c 'module purge; module load fastjet-3.3.4; module load root-5.34.38; printenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH >! modules_ld.txt; g++ -m64 -O2 AnHistograms.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o AnHistograms `root-config --cflags --libs` `fastjet-config --cxxflags --libs` -std=c++11' if ( ! -x AnHistograms ) then echo "ERROR: compilation failed" exit 1 endif set MOD_LD = `cat modules_ld.txt`
foreach f ( `cat my_files.list` ) set b = `basename ${f}` set tag = `echo ${b} | sed -e 's/^jets_//' -e 's/\.root$//'` cp ${f} ${b} if ( ! -s ${b} ) then echo "ERROR: could not copy ${f}" rm -f ${b} continue endif echo ${b} >! one.list env LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${MOD_LD}" ./AnHistograms one.list an_hists_${tag}.root >&! hist.log if ( $status != 0 || ! -f an_hists_${tag}.root ) then echo "ERROR: AnHistograms failed on ${b}" tail -5 hist.log rm -f an_hists_${tag}.root endif rm -f ${b} end ls an_hists_*.root | wc -l
